_comment: infra-platform is huge and NOT meant to be Renovate's general playground — this file exists solely to track the Authentik version pinned in ansible/sso/sso_setup.yml (COTS update tracking for the ops-portal Updates tab, see /app/issues/ for the design doc). enabledManagers below is the safety rail: without it, Renovate's default managers (terraform, ansible, docker, github-actions, npm, ...) would scan the whole repo and could open PRs across infrastructure this workflow was never meant to touch.

customManagers.description: Authentik server image, pinned identically for both blue/green slots

packageRules.description: Authentik: never auto-group major version bumps — they carry migration steps in the release notes that need a human read-through
Authentik: minor/patch can be grouped, still human-merged only (propose-only policy — see ops-portal Updates tab design)
